_readme: TODO(ariel): authored core (operating point). Every null must be a number before a scored run.
features: relative weights; score.js renormalizes over the features KNOWN for a series, so unknown never counts as zero.
penalties: subtracted from the base score. recency = w * max(0, 1 - days_since_last_run / recency_horizon_days).
click_prior = (n * median_pct + click_shrink_n * 0.5) / (n + click_shrink_n); with n = 0 it is unknown.
flex_margin: |P(Couples) - P(Golden)| at or below this makes a series flex (dual membership). On the 0-1 scale.
near_dup_action: 'flag' places near-duplicates and marks the alternative 'override'; 'skip' leaves one per cluster.
use_probable_history: true lets a title-match ('probably ran before', e.g. Mini-Makers Fun 2026-07-16) drive the recency penalty; false uses URL/record joins only.
p_include and section_fit are only known when --r7 scores are supplied; leave weights anyway.
